abstract: OBJECTIVE: Automated image analysis DNA cytometry was used to predict the pathological stage in clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patients. METHODS: Orchiectomy specimens of 74 patients (41 pathological stage I, 33 pathological stage II) were analyzed by modular image analysis computer, and several mathematical indices from the DNA histogram were calculated. RESULTS: The 5c-exceeding rate (rate of hyperpentaploid nuclei) was found to be significantly higher in patients with pathological stage II disease as compared with patients without metastases (p = 0.0174). Tumor tissue from lymph node metastases showed even higher amounts of hyperpentaploid nuclei (p < 0.0005). In this study, all patients with a 5c-exceeding rate above 3.1% had metastatic disease. CONCLUSIONS: Single-cell cytophotometry was able to show significant differences in 5c-exceeding rates between patients with and without tumor metastases. Because of high standard deviations, however, it was not possible to use this parameter for correct staging in all patients.
abstract_ja: 目的:自動画像解析DNA細胞計測を用いて、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の病理学的病期を予測すること。方法:74例(病理学的病期Iが41例、病理学的病期IIが33例)の精巣摘除標本を、モジュール式画像解析コンピュータで解析し、DNAヒストグラムから複数の数学的指標を算出した。結果:5c-exceeding rate(過五倍体核の割合)は、転移のない患者と比較して病理学的病期IIの患者で有意に高かった(p=0.0174)。リンパ節転移の組織では、さらに多くの過五倍体核が認められた(p<0.0005)。本研究では、5c-exceeding rateが3.1%を超えたすべての患者に転移が認められた。結論:単一細胞細胞光度測定により、転移の有無により5c-exceeding rateに有意差があることが示された。しかし標準偏差が大きいため、全患者で正しく病期分類するためにこのパラメータを用いることはできなかった。
